title: LostSMP
body:
# LostSMP
##### Where DonutSMP meets Lifesteal

LostSMP is a Hardcore Survival Server, where **Griefing** is allowed, and Hearts can be stolen.

#### Features:
- 💲Economy (Get RICH! Sell stuff on the Auctionhouse, or deliver orders for other players)
- 🔮AFK-Rewards (Earn 1 Shard for every Minute spent at the AFK-Pool at Spawn)
- 💔Lifesteal (Every time you get killed by another player, you lose a Heart)
- 🗡️AntiCombatLog (If you log out during combat, you lose your items and 1 Heart)
